name: repository prior
estimator: candidate evidence-object counts normalized on the axis support

name: visible query-demand proxy
estimator: distinct bilingual visible-question lexicon matches normalized by evidence role

name: visible source-affinity proxy
estimator: non-negative word-TFIDF evidence affinity summed by document and normalized

name: retrieved package
estimator: realized Top-K category mass weighted by 1/log2(rank+1)

name: locked reference
estimator: unique accepted source-derived evidence identifiers counted uniformly by category

name: normalized entropy
estimator: -sum p log2(p) / log2(number of repository categories)

name: Jensen-Shannon divergence
estimator: base-2 symmetric divergence between two normalized estimator masses
